description: Run a failed task again now, with the same prompt, provider and model. Use when: a task failed on a transient error (rate limit, 5xx). Do not use for a task that did not fail (use expedite_task to run it now, update_deadline to move it), or for a claude-code task (run `tidegap queue run-now <id>`). Behavior: one provider call now; needs the task provider's key in the server env (and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY); the new result and signed receipt replace the old ones. Returns: status (completed or failed) and error on failure. Rejects non-failed and unknown tasks.

task_id.description: Id of the failed task to run again, e.g. 't-3f2a…', from the check_queue_status list (status failed).

name: retry_task
